_provenance.status: PROVISIONAL — no preparation API contract exists. funeral-cases is unbuilt and the frozen case-events-v1 (KEB-D3-02) names no embalming/preparation endpoint, so these are app-authored demo records with provenance, exactly like lib/fixtures/family/workspace.json and lib/fixtures/agent/workspace.json.
note: WHAT THIS IS: the embalming/preparation record the staff case screen links to (Module H, crm-cases.md §12 — embalmer assignment · schedule · embalming record · dressing · cosmetics · completion checklist · staff notes; statuses scheduled / in progress / completed / cancelled). No service stores it; lib/api-client/preparation.ts answers 503 in live mode instead of inventing an endpoint.

WHAT IT CROSS-REFERENCES (pinned by tests/fixture-contract/preparation-records.test.ts): every `case_number` exists in operations/cases.json and sits at stage `preparation` or later; `embalmer` and `assistant` are employees in hr/employees.json (first + last name); the work window falls inside the case's own created_at…updated_at; each record carries exactly the four steps in work order and a completed step always carries the instant it was recorded.

NEVER INVENTED: no location, no cause of death, no amount, and no identity beyond the facts the case itself already carries. The screen copies the case's own intake fields and renders an honest `no intake yet` state when a case has none.
When a preparation contract freezes, replace this file with recorded contract fixtures and add the live branch to lib/api-client/preparation.ts.

records.notes: Family asked for the barong; no restorative work needed.
